title: MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) · sMAPE · WMAPE
prompt: Why is **MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error)** $\frac{1}{N}\sum \left|\frac{y_i - \hat{y}_i}{y_i}\right|$ broken when actual values $y_i$ can be zero or near-zero, and why is **sMAPE** asymmetric (penalizing over-forecasting vs. under-forecasting differently)? Compare with **WMAPE** and **MASE (Mean Absolute Scaled Error)**.

resources.title: Pitfalls using MAPE as forecast accuracy metric
resources.why: Why MAPE breaks near zero and with outliers.
